description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the GatewaySession component in an Android application, specifically testing WebSocket interactions, token handling, and invoke request handling in an Android environment using Robolectric and MockWebServer.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore for in-memory token storage used in tests.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class encapsulating a GatewaySession, its Job, and associated device auth store for testing.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: A data class representing the result of a node invoke scenario, including request details and result parameters.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Test class annotated to run with Robolectric, containing multiple test methods verifying WebSocket interactions, token management, and invoke request processing.

methods.name: connect_usesBootstrapTokenWhenSharedAndDeviceTokensAreAbsent
methods.description: Test that verifies the connection uses the bootstrap token when no stored device tokens are present.

methods.name: connect_prefersStoredDeviceTokenOverBootstrapToken
methods.description: Test that checks if the stored device token is preferred over the bootstrap token during connection.

methods.name: connect_retriesWithStoredDeviceTokenAfterSharedTokenMismatch
methods.description: Test that verifies retry logic with stored device token after a token mismatch error from the server.

methods.name: connect_storesPrimaryDeviceTokenFromSuccessfulSharedTokenConnect
methods.description: Test that confirms the primary device token is stored after a successful connection with a shared token response.

methods.name: bootstrapConnect_storesAdditionalBoundedDeviceTokensOnTrustedTransport
methods.description: Test that checks the storage of additional device tokens received during bootstrap connection.

methods.name: nonBootstrapConnect_ignoresAdditionalBootstrapDeviceTokens
methods.description: Test ensuring that non-bootstrap connections ignore additional bootstrap device tokens.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_roundTripsInvokeResult
methods.description: Test for a round-trip of invoke request and receive expected response.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_usesParamsJsonWhenProvided
methods.description: Test that verifies the request uses provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_mapsCodePrefixedErrorsIntoInvokeResult
methods.description: Test that error codes with specific prefixes are correctly mapped into the invoke result.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability_sendsObjectParamsAndUpdatesScopedUrl
methods.description: Test for refreshing node canvas capability, ensuring parameters are sent and URL is updated.
